title: Storybook Version Policy
description: The declared Storybook baseline: one exact version line, the addons that must be present, the modern import paths stories must use, and the legacy packages that must not come back. Fully portable — every value here is a repo's own choice, but the shape is not.

baselineDate.description: When this baseline was last deliberately reviewed, not when the file was last edited.

storybookVersion.description: Exact major.minor.patch. Ranges are the drift this file exists to prevent.

requiredImports.description: Modern import paths stories must use. Keys beyond the three required ones are allowed as Storybook's surface grows.

disallowedLegacyPackages.description: Packages an upgrade should have removed. Present here so a reintroduction is a policy failure, not a code review miss.

validationCommands.description: The commands that enforce this policy. Keep in sync with the repo's package scripts — a command listed here that no longer exists is drift.
